title: WhatsApp Builder Project Upload Workflow
description: AI-powered project creation via WhatsApp conversation. Builders can upload project details through natural language messages, and the system extracts structured data to create Project and ProjectUnit records.
features: Intent detection for project upload keywords
AI-powered data extraction from natural language
Structured extraction: project name, type, city, locality, RERA, price range, units
Confidence scoring for extraction quality (0-1 scale)
Project record creation with DRAFT status
ProjectUnit record creation for each configuration
Automatic slug generation from project name
Success message with dashboard link to edit project
acceptance_criteria: Builder can describe project in natural language
AI extracts all required fields correctly
Units created with correct configurations and prices
Confidence threshold prevents bad data (< 0.6 rejected)
Dashboard link provided for further editing
Error messages guide user to correct format
result_summary: Complete WhatsApp project upload workflow with AI extraction. Builders can add projects through conversational messages. System intelligently parses project details and creates structured records. Projects start as DRAFT for builder review via dashboard.
example_message: Godrej Garden City, Residential, Sector 27 Noida, 2BHK: 50-60L, 3BHK: 75-90L
